limits: No benchmark or quantitative image-quality comparison; model comparison is the authors' opinion with one prompt (Fig 7-12).
Model landscape is dated to early 2024 (Midjourney v6, Sora Feb 2024, Gemini image Dec 2023).
Diffusion mechanism covered in a few paragraphs, no equations, noise schedule or sampler detail.
Midjourney speculation about upscale clicks as RLHF-like data is flagged as speculation by the chapter; no source.
practices: Treat prompt engineering for diffusion models as navigating latent space to find the image matching your vision (p1).
Use different models for different jobs: DALL-E 3 for composition and ChatGPT integration, Midjourney for aesthetics, Stable Diffusion for flexibility and as a product base (Model Comparison).
Use Stable Diffusion's exposed parameters (Classifier Free Guidance, Denoising, Seed) for control (Stable Diffusion section).
